name: Brown Rice
description: Whole grain rice with only the outer hull removed. The bran and germ remain, giving brown rice more fiber, vitamins, and minerals than its white counterpart. Chewy texture with a nutty flavor.

faqs.q: Is brown rice healthier than white rice?
faqs.a: Brown rice retains the bran and germ, so it has more fiber, magnesium, and B vitamins than white rice. White rice is easier to digest and often enriched with synthetic vitamins. Both can be part of a balanced diet.

faqs.q: How many calories in a cup of cooked brown rice?
faqs.a: One cup of cooked brown rice (about 195 grams) contains roughly 240 calories. The 100 gram serving listed above contains 123 calories.
